content: Okukenga obuhya
Nyakasane ashambâza Mûsa amubwîra, erhi:
Oj’ibwîra bene Israheli erhi: Nie Nyakasane Nyamuzinda winyu;
murhakazâg’ijira nk’oku ba­jira e Mîsiri mwâli muyûbasire, murhanakazâg’ijira nk’oku bajira omu cihugo c’e Kanâni, eci namuhêkamwo; murhahîraga mwashimba amarhegeko gâbo.
Engeso zâni zo mwakâshimba, n’amarhegeko gâni go mwakaz’ilamirakwo: mugakombêre kwinjà. Nie Nyakasane Nyamuzinda winyu.
Mushimbe amarhegeko n’engeso zâni: owankabishimba kwinjà alama. Nie Nyamubâho oku­desire.
Ntâye ciru n’omuguma muli mwe oyêmêrîrwe okulâla n’omukazi w’omulala gwâge. Nie Nyakasane okudesire.
Orhahîraga okalolakwo sho erhi nyoko amango bali bushugunu, bulya ali nyoko arhayêmêrîrwi okumulolakwo analibushugunu.
Orhahîra okayambisa mukà sho obusha, bulya erhi akola sho oyo obuyambisire.
Orhahîra okayambisa mwâli winyu obusha, abè mwâli wa sho erhi mwâli wa nyoko waburhiragwa aha mwinyu, erhi embuga, orhankamuyambisa obusha.
Orhahîra okabwikûla mwâli wa mugala wâwe, ayôrhe buge­ngere, nîsi erhi mwâli wa mwâli wâwe, bulya obushugunu bwâbo buli bushugunu bwâwe wêne.
Orhahîra okabwikûla obushugunu bwa mwâli wa mukà sho, olya waburhagwa na sho, ayôsire ali mwâli winyu, co cirhumire orhankahasha okubwikûla obushugunu bwâge.
Orhahîra okabwikûla obushugunu bwa nyakashenge, bulya mubiri muguma barhengaga bona sho.
Orhahîra okubwikûla obushugunu bwa munyokò, bulya guyosire guli mubiri muguma n’ogwa nyoko.
Orhankabwikûla obushungunu bwa mûshò, kuziga orhanahîraga okayegera mukâge bulya ayôsire ali mukà mûshò, ali aka nyakashenge.
Orhankabwikûla obushugunu bwa mwâlikazi wâwe, ayôsire ali mukà mugala wâwe orhankanamubwikûla mpu ayôrhe bugengere.
Orhanka­ bwikûla obushugunu bwa mukà mwene winyu, bulya buli bushugunu bwa mwene winyu.

Orhahîra okabwikûla obushugunu bw’omukazi okanagal’i­bwikûla obushugunu bwa mwâli wâge, orhankayanka mwâli wa mugala wâge nîsi erhi mwâli wa mwâli wâge. Boshi bakola mubiri gwâge! Bulibugonyi bwa bantu ba nyumpa nguma.
Orhahîra okayanka omukazi okagal’imuhambalikanya kw’owundi w’omu nda yâbo, orhankabwikûla obushugunu bwâge onacigwêrhe olya wundi w’omu nda yâbo.
Orhahîra okayegera mpu wabwikûla obushugunu bw’omukazi ozizire, erhi kubà omu mugongo kurhuma.
Orhahîra okagona na mukà mulungu wâwe, bulya kuli kucîhemula mwenaye okwo.
Orhahîra wacîshomya mpu wahâna muguma omu bâna bâwe mpu bamugeze omu muliro lyo bakuza omuzimu Moleki, na kandi orhahemukiraga izîno lya Nyamuzinda wâwe. Nie Nyakasane okudesire.
Orhahîra okulâla n’omulume kula balâla n’omukazi. Buli buhanya obwo.
Orhahîra okalâla n’ecintu, bulya kwanarhuma wazira. N’omukazi arhankacîhà ecintu mpu cimuhambarhe. Buli buhanya obwo.
Murhahîra mukacîhemula na cijiro ciguma muli ebyo, bulya byo byahemulaga amashanja ndwîrhe nakaga mwanalola.
Ecihugo cacîbindisire, co cirhumire ncihanîre obubî bwâco. Na ntyo abalimwo bakazirwe.
Ci mwêhe mukombêre amarhegeko n’engeso zâni, munacîlange oku maligo ga mwene agôla, oli mwe, oli bambali binyu, oli ababunga muyûbasire haguma.
Bulyâla amaligo ga bene agôla, abantu barhangig’iyûbaka muli ecîra cihugo bakazir’i­gajira, na ntyo ecihugo cabindama.
Erhi mwankahemula ecihugo, k’ecôla cihugo cirhankamushala nk’oku cashalaga amashanja gali gaciyûbasiremwo embere zinyu.
Nêci, ngasi wankajira amaligo ga bene ago, anakagwa muli bene wâbo.
Mukombêre amarhegeko gâni, lyo murhag’ihirima omu ngeso mbî, za benê ezo zakazâg’ijirwa embere zinyu, lyoki zirhankamuhumânya. Nie Nyakasane Nyamuzinda winyu.
